Access & tenant matrix

Non-interactive reference. Switch "Signed in as" on the Hire profiles or Profile Detail screens to see these outcomes live.

ActionHR adminManagerNew hireSatisfies
View a profile's full dataAny profile in the tenantDirect reports onlyOwn profile onlyAC1, AC4, AC8

A denied attempt never renders profile data and never opens an edit or deactivate control — the denial happens at the point access is attempted, same as the underlying API returning a 403.

Acceptance criteria checklist

Every acceptance criterion for this story, mapped to where it's demonstrated.

1

HR admin views full profile data within the tenant — AC1

Sign in as Priya Shah (HR Admin) and open any Acme Corp profile from the hire list — every field renders.

2

HR admin's edit is saved — AC2

As Priya Shah, open a profile, click "Edit profile", change a field, and Save — the detail view and list update immediately and a "Profile updated" toast confirms it.

3

HR admin's deactivation takes effect — AC3

As Priya Shah, open an active profile and click "Deactivate profile", confirm the dialog — the status chip flips to "Deactivated" immediately.

4

Manager's hire list shows only current direct reports — AC4

Sign in as Dana Brooks or Marcus Chen — the hire list shows exactly their own direct reports, no one else's.

5

Manager with no direct reports sees an empty state — AC5

Sign in as Elena Vance (0 direct reports, until you reassign one to her) — the hire list shows "You don't have any direct reports yet" instead of a table.

6

New manager immediately gains access after reassignment — AC6

As Priya Shah, edit Felix Tran's profile and change "Hiring manager" to Elena Vance, Save. Switch to Elena Vance — Felix now appears in her list and profile, no reload needed.

7

Former manager immediately loses access after reassignment — AC7

After the same reassignment, switch to Marcus Chen — Felix Tran is gone from his list, and opening Felix's profile link now shows "Access denied".

8

New hire views their own personal details and onboarding status — AC8

Sign in as Jordan Reyes (New hire) and click "View my profile" — personal details and an "Onboarding: In progress" status render, with no edit controls.

9

Out-of-scope access is denied for any role — AC9

Use the "Try an out-of-scope profile" demo on the hire list for any signed-in role (manager, new hire, or HR admin against the Globex Corp profile) — access is refused and no data renders.

10

An error message is shown for denied access — AC10

The same demo above lands on the "Access denied" screen with a specific reason (not a direct report / not your profile / different tenant) and a way back.

11

Every profile CRUD action or access decision is logged — AC11

Open "Audit log" after any of the walkthroughs above — each view (allowed or denied), edit, and deactivation appears as a new row at the top, tagged to the Acme Corp tenant.
